editorialNotes.zh: 人工核验的公开职业与研究资料快照。方向标签为编辑概括；创始人关系不等同于现任管理职位。公司未公开命名实验室时直接关联公司，不虚构实验室。个人主页不可访问时提供本人 GitHub 或官方介绍页，并通过 homepageType 标明。当前名单为代表性入口，不是完整名录，不代表招聘、融资或合作状态。
editorialNotes.en: Manually verified snapshot of public professional and research information. Topic tags are editorial summaries. Founder relationships do not imply a current executive role. Companies without a verified named lab link directly to people. Personal GitHub or official profile pages are labelled by homepageType when used instead of a standalone homepage. Coverage is representative, not exhaustive, and does not imply recruiting, funding or collaboration status.

locationMethodology.zh: 城市依据来自机构官网、官方招聘页、官方公司账号或公司监管披露。经纬度为人工整理并四舍五入至两位小数的城市或统计地区近似中心，不是校区、楼宇、实验室或个人位置。每个机构仅选一处代表性总部、主校区或公开办公城市；不表示该机构的全部地理分布。
locationMethodology.en: City evidence comes from institutional websites, official recruiting pages, official company profiles or corporate regulatory filings. Coordinates are editorial approximate city or census-place centers rounded to two decimals, not campus, building, lab or personal locations. One representative headquarters, main-campus or publicly listed office city is selected per organization; this is not an exhaustive map of its operations.

coverageMethodology.zh: 精选机构条目，含大学、研究机构、企业及明确标注的地区办公室。每条记录采用一个公开代表地点。统计不代表法人数量、就业人数、市场规模或区域竞争力。研究方向与产业类别为编辑归类。
coverageMethodology.en: Curated institutional records include universities, institutes, companies and explicitly labelled regional offices. Each record uses one public representative location. Counts do not represent legal entities, employment, market size or regional competitiveness. Research and industry categories are editorial.
